## Installation

You can install the development version of shinygenui from GitHub with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("nanxstats/shinygenui")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r

library(shinygenui)
## basic example code
```
